{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Disability is a social restriction that affects people of every class, race, and gender.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Liberation can only be universal.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Capitalist institutions oppress people with physical, mental, and developmental impairments.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Policies that isolate disabled people from their communities are inherently oppressive.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Separate cannot be equal.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Americans with Disabilities Act has already proven wildly insufficient in guaranteeing disabled people access to the major institutions of society in its 27 years of existence.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"H.R. 620 would further weaken the Americans with Disabilities Act by removing the consequences associated with ADA non-compliance and further entrenching a system wherein disabled people are responsible for removing the barriers to accessing their communities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Accessibility is a social responsibility and a precondition for justice.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Disabled people have a material interest in ending both capitalism and ableism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The marginalization and exclusion of any social group diminishes collective capacity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
